title: Fetchlinks batch manifest (contract v2)
description: Identical to version 1 except for the version number itself. It exists because the version is what tells a publisher which post schema to validate against, and version 1 pins that number with a const. The file entry definition is referenced from version 1 rather than copied, so the two cannot drift; version 1's own file stays untouched, as an immutable contract version must.

contract_version.description: Immutable contract version. Version 2 adds origin identity to post records; every other kind is unchanged from version 1.

batch_id.description: Lexicographically sortable, time-ordered batch identifier so FIFO ordering is a plain name sort.

catalog_revision.description: Revision of the catalog snapshot the collector read, or null when it ran without one.
